command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged reads against their pinned sha256 (extracted from the 30x fixture) =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 4f43bf362b2391f03b2621226a04fb702b025d39b0a002ff2adf6d885dda4b86 reads_1.fq.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' 93f4a67742e5509e8eabfc1966c384f5e3e7faadca866d7c20a8db817a48eca0 reads_2.fq.gz
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== SPAdes --isolate, -t 4 (deterministic: verified identical across two runs) =="
spades.py --isolate -1 reads_1.fq.gz -2 reads_2.fq.gz -o out -t 4
# Flatten the one artifact we stage; leave the out/ dir and the staged reads in place
# (never rm a staged input -- sticky /tmp EPERM kills the task under set -e).
cp out/contigs.fasta contigs.fasta

# ---- smoke check ----
N=$(grep -c '^>' contigs.fasta)
BP=$(awk '!/^>/{t+=length($0)}END{print t}' contigs.fasta)
{
  echo "spades_contigs   $N   want exactly 237     (deterministic assembly, -t 4)"
  echo "spades_total_bp  $BP   want exactly 428168"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$N"  -eq 237
test "$BP" -eq 428168
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
